visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her dark hair tied in a high ponytail and wearing a black, short-sleeved athletic swimsuit with grey side panels stands inside an indoor swimming facility. She faces the camera with a cheerful, direct smile, standing in front of a wall covered in light blue mosaic tiles. (2) The woman begins a playful, rhythmic dance, shifting her body and moving her arms in time with the music. In the background, a person in dark clothing is partially visible, and a pool's edge with a metal railing and blue water is seen to the left. (3) The video cuts to a different young woman, also wearing a black athletic swimsuit, who performs a rhythmic dance toward the camera. She makes an expressive gesture, forming a heart shape with her hands and puffing her cheeks playfully while looking directly into the lens. (4) A young man wearing only patterned swimming briefs enters the frame, walking toward the camera with a bright smile. He performs a trendy social media pose, making a half-heart shape with his hand against his cheek while maintaining eye contact with the viewer. (5) The scene cuts to an outdoor or semi-outdoor aquatic park with multiple concrete diving platforms. A large splash is seen in the pool, and then a young man in swimming trunks runs along a springboard and jumps into the blue water as others watch.
